title: Planet Tweaks V3.2.7 NOVA TITAN - Zero-Delay 8 Mouse Engine, Click-Drop Purge, Intel Wi-Fi 6 Suite & Discord RPC 2.0
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.2.7 NOVA TITAN: (1) Zero-Delay 8-Packet Mouse Engine & Triple/Quad Edit Click-Drop Fix: Restored native mouclass 8-packet zero-delay ring buffer support across Watchdog, Pro Packs, and Mouse Hz Studio, eliminated AAPThreshold / SPI_SETMOUSEVANISH / USB & I2C HID D3 sleep click drops, and bypassed unnecessary user-mode WH_MOUSE_LL / WH_KEYBOARD_LL hooks for pure raw Win32 input. (2) Supercharged Zero-Delay Pro Pack (83 Verified Tweaks): Upgraded Peterbot Zero-Delay, Low-Latency, Mouse, and All-In-One packs with DirectX Flip Model, MMCSS Games priority, and zero GeForce NOW config interference. (3) Intel Wi-Fi 6 (AX200) & Zero-Jitter TCP Suite: Added Throughput Booster, CTS-to-self, No SMPS, Lowest Roaming, U-APSD disable, and TcpDisableTimerCoalesce. (4) Rebuilt Discord Rich Presence 2.0 IPC Handshake: Awaits DISPATCH READY, handles PING/PONG opcodes, and renders live HD Planet Tweaks presence. (5) 100% Full Catalog Visibility & Zero Mojibake UTF-8 UI.
